__provenance__.statement: THIS FILE IS SYNTHESISED FROM A DOCUMENT AND IS NOT A CAPTURE. It was written by reading the systemTime table of docs/opnsense-api-survey.md, which records the shape a live OPNsense 26.7 answered with on 2026-10-03; no response was recorded into this file. The values are the tests' own: datetime is the reference instant, 2026-09-27 00:00:00, written as a firewall on UTC would write it, so the offset the tests measure is zero. If the survey is wrong about a field, the tests that read this file pass and the collection is still wrong. Do not treat this file as evidence.
__provenance__.survey_section: The telemetry the data model calls gaps G9 and G10 exists
__provenance__.field_list_from: uptime, datetime, boottime, config, loadavg, each as text, from the survey's systemTime table
__provenance__.why_these_values: A wall clock at the reference instant, so the measured offset is zero; an uptime with days, hours, minutes and seconds; three load averages, of which the first is the reading.
__provenance__.example_values_are_not_a_network: Every value below is synthesised for this fixture. Nothing below describes anyone's network or firewall.
